'''Aruzans''' were the native people of [[Aruza/Legends|Aruza]]. They were small [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] or [[Near-Human]] beings with faintly blue skin and dark, almost black, hair.<ref name="Payback" />

==History==
Aruzans had the ability to share their memories and emotions with one another through [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implants]] called ''[[Attanni]]''. Aruzans felt the barriers of individual identities slip away when using their Attanni, as though they and whoever they had linked with were the same person. Certain [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] could also share these links.<ref name="Payback" />

While under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule, the peaceful Aruzans were subjected to what [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] called "processional orientation experiments". [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sinick Kritkeen]] directed these experiments in an attempt to turn the pacifist species into feral warriors who would be useful to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Though the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] was contracted by the Aruzans to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Kritkeen, it is likely that COMPNOR's "[[Redesign]]" efforts continued under a new COMPNOR officer, probably with severe reprisals carried out against the Aruzan population.<ref name="Payback" />

A famous Aruzan was [[Manaroo/Legends|Manaroo]], a dancer Dengar rescued from Aruza before she was scheduled for "processing". She later became a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] and dancer for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], and married Dengar shortly after Jabba's death.<ref name="Payback" />
